entries.name: Baker Mayfield
entries.summary: out

entries.name: Braxton Berrios
entries.summary: Berrios announced Tuesday that he will undergo foot surgery and be out for the rest of the 2026 season, Ryan Dunleavy of the New York Post reports.

entries.name: Caleb Williams
entries.summary: Bears head coach Ben Johnson said Monday that Williams (hamstring) won't practice during Week 5 and is still being classified as week-to-week rather than day-to-day, Courtney Cronin of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Durham Smythe
entries.summary: Smythe was diagnosed with a torn Achilles tendon following an MRI on Monday and will require season-ending surgery, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Tyquan Thornton
entries.summary: Thornton is slated to undergo surgery later this week to address the dislocated left ankle he sustained in Sunday's 30-27 win over the Raiders and is facing an expected recovery timeline of 3-to-4 months, Matt Zenitz of CBSSports.com reports.

entries.name: Zach Charbonnet
entries.summary: Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that Charbonnet (knee) won't be activated from the reserve/PUP list in advance of Sunday's game against the 49ers, Gregg Bell of The Tacoma News Tribune reports.

entries.name: Adonai Mitchell
entries.summary: Head coach Aaron Glenn said Wednesday that Mitchell (finger) remains week-to-week, Brian Costello of the New York Post reports.

entries.name: Breece Hall
entries.summary: Head coach Aaron Glenn said Wednesday that Hall (quadriceps) remains week-to-week, Al Iannazzone of Newsday reports.

entries.name: Dallas Goedert
entries.summary: doubtful

entries.name: Marcus Mariota
entries.summary: Mariota (knee) will not be placed on injured reserve, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Pat Bryant
entries.summary: The Broncos are confident that Bryant avoided a long-term right ankle injury after an MRI on Monday yielded good news, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Brenen Thompson
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Caleb Douglas
entries.summary: Douglas (ankle) won't practice Wednesday, Marcel Louis-Jacques of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Charlie Kolar
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Chris Brooks
entries.summary: Brooks (ankle) will not practice Wednesday, Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Chris Moore
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Colbie Young
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Colby Parkinson
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: DeVonta Smith
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: DJ Moore
entries.summary: Moore (shoulder) is dealing with an injury that isn't considered long-term, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Eli Raridon
entries.summary: Raridon (ankle) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against Buffalo.

entries.name: Hollywood Brown
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Ja'Marr Chase
entries.summary: Chase remains in the league's concussion protocol Wednesday, Ben Baby of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Jalen Coker
entries.summary: The Panthers are hopeful that Coker (quadriceps) will be ready to return to action following their Week 5 bye, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Jalen Nailor
entries.summary: Nailor (concussion) will not practice Wednesday, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Jayden Daniels
entries.summary: Daniels (elbow) was spotted throwing during the open portion of Wednesday's practice, John Keim of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Jeremiyah Love
entries.summary: Coach Mike LaFleur said Monday that Love is dealing with an ankle issue that's not related to the high-ankle sprain he tended to in August, Dani Sureck of the Cardinals' official site reports.

entries.name: Jordan Addison
entries.summary: Addison (hamstring) won't practice Wednesday, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Justin Jefferson
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Keenan Allen
entries.summary: Allen (groin) is practicing Wednesday, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Ko Kieft
entries.summary: Kieft (elbow) was a limited participant in practice Tuesday.

entries.name: Konata Mumpfield
entries.summary: Mumpfield suffered a rotator cuff contusion during Sunday's 24-20 win over the Eagles, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports.

entries.name: Kyle Monangai
entries.summary: Head coach Ben Johnson said Wednesday that Monangai's thumb injury is not an issue, Courtney Cronin of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Ladd McConkey
entries.summary: McConkey (foot), per head coach Jim Harbaugh, is "week-to-week," Alex Insdorf of BoltBeat.com reports.

entries.name: Lamar Jackson
entries.summary: Jackson (ankle) wasn't participating in the media-access portion of Wednesday's practice, Jamison Hensley of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Mack Hollins
entries.summary: Hollins (calf) isn't expected to practice Wednesday, Evan Lazar of the Patriots' official site reports.

entries.name: Mason Taylor
entries.summary: Taylor (thumb) will practice Wednesday, Eric Allen of the Jets' official site reports.

entries.name: Noah Fant
entries.summary: Fant (abdomen) is listed as inactive for Monday's game against the Falcons.

entries.name: Rachaad White
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Rashee Rice
entries.summary: Rice (hamstring) is believed to have sustained a "relatively minor" injury in Sunday's win over the Raiders and could be ready to play following the Chiefs' Week 5 bye, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Rhamondre Stevenson
entries.summary: Stevenson (undisclosed) is not expected to practice Wednesday, Taylor Kyles of CLNSMedia.com reports.

entries.name: Rico Dowdle
entries.summary: Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy said that Dowdle (toe) will remain in the rehab group for Wednesday's practice, but the running back is expected to do more on-field work later in the week, Ray Fittipaldo of the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette reports.

entries.name: Saquon Barkley
entries.summary: Eagles head coach Nick Sirianni didn't provide an update on Barkley's status Monday when asked about the hamstring injury the running back sustained during Sunday's loss to the Rams, Zach Berman of The Athletic reports. "We'll have more answers Wednesday probably with that stuff," Sirianni added.

entries.name: Stefon Diggs
entries.summary: Diggs (undisclosed) was not on the practice field during the portion of Wednesday's practice open to the media, John Keim of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Tee Higgins
entries.summary: Higgins (adductor) will be limited in practice Wednesday, Ben Baby of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Terry McLaurin
entries.summary: McLaurin (hamstring) won't practice Wednesday, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

entries.name: Tylan Wallace
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: A.J. Brown
entries.summary: Brown (ankle) was seen in the locker room Wednesday without a noticeable limp, Doug Kyed of the Boston Herald reports.

entries.name: Alec Pierce
entries.summary: Colts head coach Shane Steichen reiterated Monday that Pierce didn't undergo surgery on his left heel and is continuing to rehab the injury, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Arian Smith
entries.summary: Smith (knee) underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn ACL and will miss the rest of the season, Antwan V. Staley of the New York Daily News reports.

entries.name: British Brooks
entries.summary: Brooks (hamstring) was placed on injured reserve Friday.

entries.name: Christian Kirk
entries.summary: Head coach Kyle Shanahan said Friday that the 49ers could open Kirk's (calf) practice window to return from injured reserve in two weeks, Matt Barrows of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: De'Von Achane
entries.summary: The Dolphins placed Achane (knee) on injured reserve Monday.

entries.name: Dillon Gabriel
entries.summary: The Browns opened the 21-day practice window for Gabriel (back) on Tuesday.

entries.name: Dont'e Thornton Jr.
entries.summary: The Raiders designated Thornton (undisclosed) for return from injured reserve Wednesday, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Hunter Long
entries.summary: The Cardinals placed Long (knee) on injured reserve Tuesday.

entries.name: Jack Bech
entries.summary: The Raiders placed Bech (forearm) on injured reserve Tuesday.

entries.name: Jadarian Price
entries.summary: Price (chest) was placed on injured reserve Saturday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Jayden Reed
entries.summary: The Packers are expected to place Reed (neck) on injured reserve Wednesday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Jaylin Lane
entries.summary: The Commanders placed Lane (ankle) on injured reserve Tuesday.

entries.name: Jonah Coleman
entries.summary: Coleman (ankle) is being placed on injured reserve Saturday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Jordyn Tyson
entries.summary: Tyson (hamstring) is said to be making progress and feeling good but isn't expected to be activated from injured reserve until Week 7 at the soonest, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Josh Oliver
entries.summary: The Vikings placed Oliver (biceps) on injured reserve Tuesday, Craig Peters of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Tank Bigsby
entries.summary: The Eagles placed Bigsby (abdomen) on injured reserve Tuesday, Zach Berman of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Tank Dell
entries.summary: The Texans designated Dell (knee) to return from injured reserve Wednesday.

entries.name: Terrance Ferguson
entries.summary: Ferguson (ankle) is expected to be ready to return after his four-game stint on injured reserve, Cameron DaSilva of USA Today reports.

entries.name: Tim Patrick
entries.summary: The Jets designated Patrick (groin) to return from injured reserve Wednesday.

entries.name: Travis Etienne Jr.
entries.summary: The Saints are placing Etienne (hamstring) on injured reserve, Katherine Terrell of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Trevor Etienne
entries.summary: Head coach Dave Canales said Etienne (ankle) will "for sure" be back following the Panthers' Week 5 bye, Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Xavier Legette
entries.summary: The Panthers placed Legette (knee) on injured reserve Saturday, Darin Gantt of the team's official site reports.
